decisions.quote: The study confirmed the factor structure of a streamlined 24-item FEMS-T, which exhibited better fit than the original 40 items identified by Wilfong (2021).
decisions.reason: The abstract states only that a streamlined 24-item version confirmed the factor structure and fit better than Wilfong's (2021) original 40-item scale, without stating whether the original 40-item scale itself held or failed or whether the invariance findings contrast with Wilfong (2021). Because only the abstract is available, the evidence does not settle whether the replication outcome is successful or mixed.
